title: ticketd outbound mail message (observed)
description: Emitting sites: ticketd/app/server.py:76 (close), :94 (reset request), via ticketd/app/notify.py:5-7. Consumer: smtp.internal. The harness mail sink captures messages in this shape on BOTH trees; after the PB-001 repair the modern side emits the same message via its dispatcher (mode 'queued'). Body is a headerless raw string (NT-2).
